mapper.sql: a.public_id AS asset_public_id, dm.diary_id, d.user_id, dm.sort, d.title AS diary_title, d.date AS diary_date, d.mood_key, CASE WHEN fm.asset_id IS NULL THEN false ELSE true END AS favorite, COALESCE(d.created_at,a.created_at) AS created_at

FROM media_asset a LEFT JOIN diary_media dm ON dm.asset_id = a.asset_id AND dm.diary_id = ( SELECT dm_pick.diary_id FROM diary_media dm_pick INNER JOIN diary d_pick ON d_pick.diary_id = dm_pick.diary_id WHERE dm_pick.asset_id = a.asset_id AND d_pick.user_id = #{userId} AND d_pick.deleted_at IS NULL AND d_pick.locked = 0 ORDER BY d_pick.date DESC,dm_pick.sort,dm_pick.diary_id DESC LIMIT 1 ) LEFT JOIN diary d ON d.diary_id = dm.diary_id LEFT JOIN favorite_media fm ON fm.asset_id = a.asset_id AND fm.user_id = #{userId} WHERE a.owner_user_id = #{userId} AND a.space_id=(SELECT space_id FROM diary_space WHERE personal_owner_id=#{userId}) AND a.media_type = 'IMAGE' AND a.library_visible = 1 AND a.access_scope <> 'PROFILE' AND a.deleted_at IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM diary_media dm_locked INNER JOIN diary d_locked ON d_locked.diary_id=dm_locked.diary_id WHERE dm_locked.asset_id=a.asset_id AND d_locked.deleted_at IS NULL AND d_locked.locked=1 )

sql.if: AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM diary_tag dt WHERE dt.diary_id = d.diary_id AND dt.tag_id = #{tagId})

ORDER BY COALESCE(d.date,DATE(a.taken_at),DATE(a.created_at)) DESC, dm.sort ASC, a.asset_id DESC

SELECT a.public_id
AND COALESCE(d.date,DATE(a.taken_at),DATE(a.created_at)) >= STR_TO_DATE(#{startDate}, '%Y-%m-%d')
AND COALESCE(d.date,DATE(a.taken_at),DATE(a.created_at)) <= STR_TO_DATE(#{endDate}, '%Y-%m-%d')
AND fm.asset_id IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY COALESCE(d.date,DATE(a.taken_at),DATE(a.created_at)) DESC, dm.sort ASC, a.asset_id DESC LIMIT 1

AND a.public_id IN

SELECT a.public_id AS asset_public_id, dm.diary_id, d.user_id, dm.sort, d.title AS diary_title, d.date AS diary_date, d.mood_key, CASE WHEN fm.asset_id IS NULL THEN false ELSE true END AS favorite, d.created_at FROM media_asset a LEFT JOIN diary_media dm ON dm.asset_id = a.asset_id AND dm.diary_id = ( SELECT MIN(dm_pick.diary_id) FROM diary_media dm_pick INNER JOIN diary d_pick ON d_pick.diary_id=dm_pick.diary_id WHERE dm_pick.asset_id=a.asset_id AND d_pick.user_id=#{userId} AND d_pick.deleted_at IS NULL AND d_pick.locked=0 ) LEFT JOIN diary d ON d.diary_id = dm.diary_id LEFT JOIN favorite_media fm ON fm.asset_id = a.asset_id AND fm.user_id = #{userId} WHERE a.owner_user_id = #{userId} AND a.public_id = #{assetId} AND a.space_id=(SELECT space_id FROM diary_space WHERE personal_owner_id=#{userId}) AND a.media_type = 'IMAGE' AND a.library_visible=1 AND a.access_scope <> 'PROFILE' AND a.deleted_at IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM diary_media dm_locked INNER JOIN diary d_locked ON d_locked.diary_id=dm_locked.diary_id WHERE dm_locked.asset_id=a.asset_id AND d_locked.deleted_at IS NULL AND d_locked.locked=1 )
